_note: The shared fixture of the gfm-pipe-table crate and its TypeScript twin @osdlc/gfm-table.
Offsets are UTF-8 byte offsets; the TypeScript runners convert from UTF-16 indices.
A refusal is {"error": kind}. Add a case here, never in one package alone.
_inputs lists each section's input keys. A case holds name, expected and only those;
both runners fail on any other key.
